decision: PHASE 1 CLEAN-BUILD RESET (owner, 2026-10-04): the staging service has no production users, so Phase 1 is a clean build of the FINAL single-host topology and its direct certification, not a continuity-preserving migration. The final topology, the money/security authorities and the $30/month ceiling are unchanged (docs/hosting-budget.md, infra/aws/COST_BUDGET.json).
scope: Every AWS resource the repository's Terraform declares (modules/app, modules/ledger, modules/single-host -- each declaration classified exactly once, pinned by server/src/aws/deploy/migration/phase1CleanBuild.test.ts) and every resource outside Terraform that the repository's procedures created, depend on or must remove. Live names are staging's (environment `staging`); another environment substitutes its own. This is the SOURCE classification; P1-R1 confirms it read-only against live AWS and STOPS on any live resource it cannot place here.

classes.KEEP-DURABLE: KEEP -- durable application / security authority (never deleted, replaced or moved by Phase 1)
classes.KEEP-HOST: KEEP -- the final low-cost hosting plane (stacks/single-host and its DNS)
classes.DELETE-LEGACY: DELETE -- legacy ECS-era hosting belonging only to this workload
classes.DELETE-MIGRATION: DELETE -- migration / drill-only resource, only after its stated proof
classes.REVIEW: REVIEW -- ownership or shared-use ambiguity: never deleted by Phase 1 without the stated evidence and an owner decision

stacks/app.edge.alb_origin_domain_name: <the host's origin_hostname> (the /gs* origin; the origin id stays gs-alb)
stacks/app.note: compute has NO default in stacks/app (PHASE 1 CLEAN-BUILD RESET): every plan states it. alb.* and network.*_subnet_ids stay in the tfvars as inert legacy inputs (no resource reads them under compute = "none").

stacks/ledger.note: ecs_task_role_authorized has NO default in stacks/ledger (PHASE 1 CLEAN-BUILD RESET): after the teardown a forgotten line can no longer silently re-grant the deleted task role's name.

stacks/single-host.note: The live host was created from 5b4756d and its three changed scripts installed by runbook 13r: plan this stack ONLY from 5b4756d (its module is byte-identical at 61f6c82) unless the host is deliberately rebuilt (PHASE1_CLEAN_BUILD.md R4).
